description: The Shared Signals receiver of inbound SETs, pushed to /ssf/receiver/events or polled from a transmitter: a SET it refused, one it discarded, and a subject its handlers could not map to anyone here. The SET, its jti and its subject are never event fields.

handler.description: Which handler could not map the subject: grants (the PingFederate grant revocation) or instance_registry (the agent instance registry).

format.description: The subject's format (iss_sub, email, complex, aliases and so on), or none.

ssf.receiver.set_refused.description: A SET was refused with an RFC 8935 error, the reason: invalid_request (unparseable, or carrying exp or sub, which SSF 1.0 forbids), invalid_key, invalid_issuer or invalid_audience. A push is answered 400; a polled SET is reported in setErrs.

ssf.receiver.set_discarded.description: A SET was accepted and not acted on: its complex subject carries a member the transmitter declared critical that the handlers do not act on (SSF 1.0 §3.6); reason critical_subject_member.

ssf.receiver.subject_unmapped.description: A handler acted on nothing because the SET's subject names no user or device here (an iss_sub from another issuer, a complex subject with no user or device member, an aliases subject none of whose identifiers maps); reason unmapped.
